bullets.text: Heavy overnight rain caused waterlogging and disrupted roads in Chennai, and the office should monitor drainage and road restoration efforts.
Residents reported severe mosquito nuisance at a major mall in the Velachery 174th ward, and the office should inspect sanitation measures.
Sewage stagnation in Gummidipoondi SIPCOT drains caused health concerns among workers, and the office should ensure immediate cleanup.
Migrant workers fell ill after eating mushrooms near Ponneri, and the office should check food safety compliance in the area.
Public demand arose in Thiruvallur to operate the Chennai-Arakkonam suburban express train with twelve coaches, and the office should track this proposal.
Bihar launched its AI Policy 2026 targeting training for five lakh youth, and the office should note these nationwide skilling benchmarks.
Experts highlighted the urgency for independent system checks and mandatory incident reporting for artificial intelligence, and the office should monitor these defence frameworks.
